blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Mandaue City Government and the Cebu Provincial Sports Commission (CPSC) are stepping up preparations for the grand opening of the Governor’s Cup Under-18 Basketball Tournament on September 27 at the newly renovated Mandaue City Cultural and Sports Complex. As the host local government unit, Mandaue City is prioritizing security, traffic management, venue preparations, and other logistical requirements to ensure the smooth conduct of the opening ceremony and the tournament. CPSC Commissioner Mark Anthony Inoc, Executive Director Rodrigo Tanza Jr., and other commission representatives recently paid a courtesy call on Mandaue City Mayor Thadeo Jovito “Jonkie” O. […]...
